item.title: Towards robust separation of the cosmological 21-cm signal: structured modeling, regularization, and Bayesian inference
item.description:
About this document

This independent research proposal is based on an analysis of several studies of cosmological 21-cm signal separation using Gaussian process regression (GPR and ML-GPR).

It considers two complementary methodological directions: structured contaminant modeling and regularization of learned covariance models, together with a probabilistic and Bayesian strategy for evaluating the separation.

Initial version: September 30, 2026. Revised version: November 9, 2026.
